verdict.rationale: GoDaddy documents an availability-check endpoint and alternative-name discovery via API and MCP, so instant availability and suggestions are covered as first-party capabilities. The 'honest, no lookup-then-squat' part has no vendor evidence. Community hands-on reports describe GoDaddy registering domains shortly after users searched them, which directly undercuts that element of the story. Missing for 10: any documented guarantee against front-running or protection of searched names, explicit alternate-TLD suggestion behavior (docs say alternative names by keyword), evidence of search speed, and independent corroboration that search is trustworthy.

support.subject: As a founder, domain search is fast and honest — instant availability, alternate TLD suggestions, and no lookup-then-squat games on names I searched

citations.quote: Search operations let you check whether a specific domain is available for registration, and discover alternative names based on keywords or natural-language queries.
The GoDaddy MCP server lets AI assistants search for domain names and check domain availability directly from a conversation
